text.tspan: Level 3 · Core protocols: the order to read the lessons
"What happens when you type a URL": DNS → route → ARP → TCP → NAT → TLS → HTTP
Practise as you go: Labs 3.1 to 3.5 (TCP handshake · DNS · TLS · NAT · troubleshooting challenge)
★ = very likely interview topic (⭐ in the lessons table)
